note: Negative: `flatBand` is authored as 0. Zero is the adversarial value rather than an absent key — it is finite, it looks authored, and it passes every absence check, yet `resolved-flat` is `|outcomeValue| <= flatBand`, so a zero band makes the flat class unreachable and silently absorbs a genuinely flat outcome into `unresolved`. The band is frozen at PROPOSAL time (HC-6), so it is authored or the claim is not evaluable — never defaulted. Everything else is complete.
